2. Daily Wages .. If the nature of the casual workers and regular employees is the same, casual workers should be paid at VJo th of pay at the minimum of pay scale of the regular post plus D.A. (HRA will not be taken
- into account).  
If the nature of work is different, minimum wage as notified by the  
State Government/UT as per the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, is payable.
